items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Baptist. The interviewer asks 'Hey, Baptist?' and responds with 'I know the place, and I've talked to him on the phone', indicating the interviewer's connection, not the interviewee's.

ctx.x: But anyhow, that's the first guy I saw in Chicago. I saw his name in the neon sign, man. Johnny Toast's Orchestra. Oh, yeah. My God, Johnny Toast's Orchestra, man. He was playing at, you know Chicago. He was playing on Wilson Avenue, and Clarence Beach, where the Clarence Beach is, or Wilson Avenue, or upstairs at the Beachview Garden. I can't play seven. Well, right now he's here, his hands are all white like mine, but it's a flat top. I tell you, you might interview him sometimes. There's another station on…

Yeah. I know the place, and I've talked to him on the phone, but he says he hasn't lived in the past. Well, he's kind of, I believe. Please. Well, it's all right. Okay. Well, he, yeah, he told me about McCoskey was in the band, and maybe Jack Asano. Yeah.
